frontier: The canonical authenticated terminal attach path could block indefinitely if a per-user tmux control operation wedges: PR #528's has-session, source-file policy reapply, and new-session subprocess calls had no timeout even though policy attestation elsewhere was already bounded.
repair: Add one shared 2.0 second TMUX_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS bound for attach-path tmux control operations.
Fail closed with TerminalRuntimeError when has-session cannot complete because of OSError or TimeoutExpired.
Fail closed with TerminalRuntimeError when managed tmux policy reapplication cannot complete.
Fail closed when new-session cannot complete and do not continue to policy/attach admission after the timeout.
Remain stacked on PR #528 rather than creating a competing terminal/runtime architecture.
